name: runsteady
title: Integrate an ODE to steady state

origin.description: Integrates until the mean absolute derivative drops below stol.
origin.usage: runsteady(y, time = c(0, Inf), func, parms, stol = 1e-8, rtol = 1e-6, atol = 1e-6, ...)

arguments.name: y
arguments.text: Initial state. Names are kept when y is a dict.

arguments.name: func
arguments.text: func(time, state, parms) returns a list whose first element is the derivatives.

arguments.name: parms
arguments.text: Passed through to func. NULL when the model has no parameters.

arguments.name: stol
arguments.text: Steady when the mean of the absolute derivatives is below this.

origin.details: The integrator is LSODA. Its step is tightened so the returned state is the first crossing of stol. DLSODE's last step on dy/dt = 1 - y lands 1.1e-10 from that crossing.
origin.value: A list with y. precis is the mean absolute derivative. steady is TRUE when the crossing was reached.
origin.example: runsteady(y = 0, func = function(t, y, p) list(1 - y), time = c(0, Inf))

translation.description: Integrates until the mean absolute derivative drops below stol.
translation.usage: runsteady(y, times=None, func=None, parms=None, stol=1e-8, rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-6, **kwargs)

arguments.name: y
arguments.text: Initial state. Names are kept when y is a dict.

arguments.name: func
arguments.text: func(time, state, parms) returns a list whose first element is the derivatives.

arguments.name: parms
arguments.text: Passed through to func. NULL when the model has no parameters.

arguments.name: stol
arguments.text: Steady when the mean of the absolute derivatives is below this.

translation.details: The integrator is LSODA. Its step is tightened so the returned state is the first crossing of stol. DLSODE's last step on dy/dt = 1 - y lands 1.1e-10 from that crossing.
translation.value: A list with y. precis is the mean absolute derivative. steady is TRUE when the crossing was reached.
translation.example:
from rootSolve import runsteady

def approach(t, y, p):
    return [[1.0 - value for value in y]]

print(runsteady([0.0], func=approach, times=[0, float('inf')]))
